title: One glass door, four storefronts
body: Quartz Mart, Corner Café, Depot Corner Shop and Mirror Lake Café share one narrow-framed glass door. We kept the views at entrance height so you can compare what changes around it, from the mart’s shop windows to the wall and trim at each café. Quartz Mart also has a separate receiving entrance around back.
